module_title: Intermediate Matrix - Bird Sanctuaries & Wildlife Sanctuary Grid
introduction: This level focuses exclusively on preparing you for the dreaded 'Match the Following' questions in RO/ARO and UPPSC Prelims. You must develop a strong geographical mapping of which sanctuary resides in which specific district.

core_concepts.title: Crucial Bird Sanctuaries
core_concepts.description:
- **Nawabganj Bird Sanctuary:** Unnao (Renamed Shaheed Chandra Shekhar Azad).
- **Samaspur Bird Sanctuary:** Raebareli.
- **Parvati Arga Bird Sanctuary:** Gonda.
- **Bakhira Bird Sanctuary:** Sant Kabir Nagar.
- **Sandi Bird Sanctuary:** Hardoi.
- **Saman Bird Sanctuary:** Mainpuri.
- **Okhla Bird Sanctuary:** Situated exactly on the border of Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida) and Ghaziabad.

core_concepts.title: Specialized Bird Habitats & Lakes
core_concepts.description:
- **Sur Sarovar (Keetham Lake):** Agra.
- **Surha Taal Bird Sanctuary:** Ballia (Also known as Jai Prakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary).
- **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Bird Sanctuary (Beti Taal):** Pratapgarh.

core_concepts.title: Major Wildlife Sanctuaries
core_concepts.description:
- **Chandraprabha WLS:** Chandauli (The very first WLS in the state).
- **Kaimur WLS:** Mirzapur and Sonbhadra (Spans the Vindhyan ranges).
- **Katarniaghat WLS:** Bahraich (Critical for Gharial and Tiger conservation, forms part of the Dudhwa landscape).
- **Suhagi Barwa WLS:** Maharajganj (Located along the Gandak river).
- **Turtle Wildlife Sanctuary (Kachhua Sanctuary):** Varanasi (A unique 7 km stretch of the Ganga river dedicated exclusively to turtle conservation).

important_entities.name: National Chambal Wildlife Sanctuary
important_entities.significance: Located across Agra and Etawah, this sanctuary is co-managed by Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan. It is globally significant for harboring the largest remaining population of the critically endangered **Gharial** and the Ganges River Dolphin.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
These two phonetically similar bird sanctuaries frequently cause negative marking:
- **Saman** Bird Sanctuary = **Mainpuri**.
- **Samaspur** Bird Sanctuary = **Raebareli**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Phonetically, 'Gonda' sounds like 'Goda' (Hindi for Lap). Think of Goddess Parvati's lap to instantly map Parvati Arga to the Gonda district.

exam_strategy_tips: In RO/ARO, you will typically get a 4x4 matching grid. Memorizing the Bakhira ➡️ Sant Kabir Nagar and Sandi ➡️ Hardoi pairings will often allow you to eliminate incorrect options and solve the entire grid.
